question: In which state of India is the Sri Brahmapureeswarar temple situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hindu temple Sri Brahmapureeswarar **is situated in **Thirupattur, Tamil Nadu,** India.
 
• Those who practice this religion think that by requesting** Brahma's blessings**, one might alter his or her destiny.
 
• The temple complex, which also includes the** garden next to the temple**, contains** 12 Shiv Lingams.**
 
• Brahma **erected and worshiped** these Shiva Lingams.
 
• Other **famous temples** in Tamil Nadu are Kapaleeswarar Temple, Brihadeeswarar Temple, Meenakshi Temple, Ramanathaswamy Temple, Kumari Amman temple, and Naganathaswamy Temple.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **State**
 **Temples**
 
 

 Andhra Pradesh
 Yaganti Temple, Tirumala Venkateswara Temple, Siva Mallikarjuna Temple, Simhachalam Temple, Mallikarjuna Swamy, Lepakshi Temple, Kanipakam Vinayaka Temple, Kanaka Durga Temple.
 
 

 Rajasthan
 Brahma temple in Pushkar, Eklingji temple in Udaipur, Ambika Mata temple in Jagat, Karni Mata Mandir in Deshnoke, Salasar Balaji Temple in Salasar, Mehendipur Balaji Temple in Karauli, Sai Dham at Rani, Birla Mandir in Jaipur.
 
 

 Manipur
 
 
Mahabali Temple, Shri Govindaji Temple, Krishna Temple, Sanamahi Temple, Nityananda And Narasimha Temple, Radha-krishna Chandra Iskcon Temple.
